title: Adaptive downgrade graph for version-locked serving
creator: Riley Chen
description: Build an adaptive downgrade graph and decision layer for endpoints where customers pin to a specific model artifact or version. The feature should allow the runtime to automatically select safe fallback targets when the pinned version is unavailable, degraded, or deprecated while honoring region affinity, customer isolation (Dedicated/Private), and unit-cost SLOs. This ticket covers the policy model, runtime orchestration hooks, model metadata changes for published performance profiles, and the controlled rollout path for canarying the downgrade logic.
acceptance_criteria: Runtime can resolve a fallback chain for any pinned version using a priority-ordered graph stored in model catalog metadata
Fallback decision respects region preference and customer deployment mode (hosted, dedicated, private) before selecting model-variant downgrades
Deprecation signals in the catalog trigger automated warning events, and a configured soft-fail window where the system routes traffic to the next viable variant without dropping requests
Performance profile publishing is consulted by the decision layer so fallback target selection keeps latency and token-cost within configured thresholds
End-to-end canary (10% traffic) of the downgrade graph activated for runtime-1.24 with metric alerts for error-rate, p95 latency regression, and mismatch rate vs golden prompts
implementation_notes: Extend model catalog schema: add 'fallback_graph' array and 'deprecation_window' fields on model-version entries
Decision engine will evaluate: availability -> region affinity -> variant compatibility (ops semantics) -> perf profile delta -> cost thresholds -> final scoring
Use existing smart-routing layer hooks; add 'fallback-reason' codes for observability (UNAVAILABLE, DEGRADED_PERF, DEPRECATED, CAPACITY_LIMIT)
KV cache compatibility: when switching to a model variant, ensure cache key namespace includes model-variant tag to avoid cross-model pollution
Provide an admin console view for per-customer fallback rules and an override API for enterprise accounts
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (dev): unit tests and decision engine simulator for synthetic scenarios
Phase 2 (staging): publish sample fallback graphs for 3 curated models, run chaos where primary model process is terminated
Phase 3 (canary): enable automatic downgrade for 5% of traffic on runtime-1.24, monitor p95/p99 and cost delta for 72h
Phase 4 (ramp): increment to 50% then 100% after validation; expose console toggle and audit logs
risks: Incorrect scoring could route traffic to semantically incompatible variants causing output regressions
Aggressive automatic downgrades could violate customer SLAs if not properly scoped to Dedicated/private offerings
Telemetry gaps could hide slow regressions from perf-profile mismatches
KV cache invalidation complexity could increase latency during variant switches
test_plan: Decision engine unit tests covering all reason codes and extreme performance deltas
Integration test: simulate regional outage and verify graceful routing to alternative region+variant within SLOs
Golden prompt eval set: compare top-3 fallback candidates against primary for semantic fidelity and surface mismatch rate
Chaos test: degrade primary node CPU to force performance fallback and assert no request loss
